label.purpose: Group headers, name tags, Pick, status-bar name (Figtree SemiBold 12).

caption-medium.purpose: Task numbers, pills, runtimes, segment labels (Figtree Medium 12).

caption.purpose: Counts, hints, project names, tooltips (Figtree Regular 12, Moss Grey).

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Modal dialog card above the scrim.

motion.name: none
motion.purpose: Motionless by design: hover, press and focus are instant colour swaps; dialogs appear without transition. The only moving content is the once-per-second runtime text.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one call to action of a view: ICQ Green fill, 32px tall, 8px radius.

components.name: Pick Button
components.description: Compact primary at the right edge of a row whose plan is ready; claims the task and copies the prompt.
components.html:
id_button(
    format!("pick-{}", task.number),
    container(row![icon(Icon::Pick, 14.0, Tone::OnPrimary), text("Pick").size(TS_12).font(SEMIBOLD)]
        .spacing(SP_1).align_y(Alignment::Center)).padding([SP_1, 10.0]),
    (!busy && app.picking.is_none()).then_some(Message::Pick(task.number)),
    theme::button_primary,
    Length::Shrink,
)
// wrapped: with_tip(.., "Claim it and copy a prompt for your agent")

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bordered raised button for the non-primary choice next to a primary (Cancel, Replan, Add).

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive decision (Reject): red text and outline, red fill only while pressed.

components.name: Icon Button (ghost)
components.description: Borderless 32x32 icon button with a tooltip; toolbar, dialog headers, edit pencils.
components.html:
icon_button("settings", Icon::Settings, Tone::Text, "Settings  (Ctrl+,)", Some(Message::OpenSettings), theme::button_ghost)
// icon_button = with_tip(id_button(id, container(icon(glyph, 16.0, tone)).padding(SP_2), on_press, style, Length::Shrink), tip)

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Raised field with a hairline border, Sage Edge on hover, 2px Leaf Ink focus ring; Enter submits.

components.name: Task Row
components.description: One-line buddy-list row: stage flower, #number, title, priority arrow, member tag, Pick button.
components.html:
id_button(
    format!("task-{}", task.number),
    container(row![
        flower(task, 16.0),
        text(format!("#{}", task.number)).size(TS_12).font(MEDIUM).style(theme::text_muted),
        text(&task.title).size(TS_14).width(Length::Fill),
        // priority arrow, member_tag(name, hue), Pick button
    ].spacing(SP_2).align_y(Alignment::Center)).padding([6.0, SP_2]),
    Some(Message::OpenTask(task.number)),
    theme::button_row,
    Length::Fill,
)

components.name: Group Header
components.description: Foldable group title with chevron and count (In progress, Ready to pick, Planning, Proposals, Done).
components.html:
id_button(
    format!("group-{}", group.slug()),
    container(row![
        icon(chevron, 14.0, Tone::Muted),
        text(group.title()).size(TS_12).font(SEMIBOLD),
        muted(count.to_string()),
    ].spacing(6).align_y(Alignment::Center)).padding([SP_1, SP_1]),
    Some(Message::ToggleGroup(group)),
    theme::button_row,
    Length::Fill,
)

components.name: Member Tag
components.description: Fully round name tag in the member's fixed hue (one of six); light fill / dark text by day, inverted by night.

components.name: Pill
components.description: Quiet round label for counters and stage labels (idle, Plan ready).

components.name: Status Flower
components.description: The signature: an eight-petal flower tinted by stage; outline while only proposed, filled afterwards.

components.name: Status Bar
components.description: 32px mint bar: server flower, my name, room switcher, server and MCP dots.
components.html:
container(row![
    icon(Icon::Flower, 14.0, Tone::Bloom(bloom)),
    text(&app.settings.name).size(TS_12).font(SEMIBOLD),
    pick_list(choices, selected, |c| Message::SelectRoom(c.id))
        .text_size(TS_12).padding([2.0, SP_2]).style(theme::picker).menu_style(theme::picker_menu),
    Space::new().width(Length::Fill),
    with_tip(row![dot(server), muted(server_label)].spacing(SP_1), server_tip),
    with_tip(row![dot(mcp_state), muted("MCP")].spacing(SP_1), mcp_tip),
].spacing(SP_2).align_y(Alignment::Center))
.padding([SP_1, SP_2]).height(32).align_y(Alignment::Center).width(Length::Fill).style(theme::chrome)

components.description: Modal card over the scrim: header with close, scrolling body, pinned footer; max 560px wide.
components.html:

narrative.overview:
The room is a buddy list. Tasks are contacts, each with a status flower; groups fold like ICQ groups; whoever works on a task wears a coloured name tag. The look is a modern, fresh ICQ: ICQ green on white by day, deep green-black by night, mint-tinted chrome, Figtree type, rounded 8px rows. It lives as a narrow window (400x780) beside the editor and terminal and is read in a glance, so everything is quiet, flat and tinted toward green; the only saturated things on screen are the flowers, the name tags and the green action fills.

The system is flat and calm. Depth is tonal (ground white, chrome mint, raised cards) with soft shadows only on things that float: dialogs, tooltips, the room-switcher menu. There is no motion by design: state changes are instant colour swaps, nothing animates, nothing blurs. Two themes, Daylight and Night, follow the system appearance (no preference means Night); every colour comes from the active theme's token set.

The signature is the stage-coloured eight-petal flower on every task row and in the status bar. It is the one status device: colour is the stage, outline-versus-filled marks the very first stage. It refuses the Kanban board and the wide three-pane admin layout.
keyCharacteristics: Buddy-list structure: foldable groups of one-line rows, pick button at the right edge of finished plans.
One saturated green for actions (`ICQ Green`), a separate leaf green for ink and focus, a separate running green for the flower.
Every neutral leans mint-green; no cool or pure greys.
Six member tag hues, fixed per member, identical for everyone; light fills with dark text by day, dark fills with light text by night.
Figtree only, four weights (400 / 500 / 600 / 700), three sizes in practice (12 / 14 / 20).
Flat rows, 1px hairlines, modal dialogs over a green-black scrim.

rules.name: The Flower Carries Status Rule
rules.body: Stage is shown by the flower colour and nowhere else on a row: no row backgrounds, side stripes or coloured titles. A stage colour is never used for anything but a stage (and the server state mapped onto the same flower in the status bar).

rules.name: The Three Greens Rule
rules.body: Green means three different things and they do not swap: *ICQ Green* fills actions, *Leaf Ink* writes text and the focus ring, *Running Green* marks a running agent or a live connection. An action never takes the running hue and a flower never takes the action hue.

rules.name: The Mint Neutrals Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is tinted toward the green hue; chrome is mint, lines are mint, text is green-black. No pure grey, no blue-grey.

rules.name: The Colour Plus Form Rule
rules.body: Colour is never the only carrier. The flower sits next to a group title and, in the task dialog, next to a stage pill ("Plan ready", "In progress"); New is outline, not just grey. Name tags carry the member's name.

rules.name: The Three Sizes Rule
rules.body: 12 for captions, tags and counters; 14 for anything read as content; 20 for titles. Plan markdown steps `h2` 17 and `h3` 15 between them; nothing else invents a size.

rules.name: The Weight Does the Work Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is a weight step (400, 500, 600, 700), never a size jump, an underline or tracking.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Anything inside the window is flat; only a surface that floats above it (dialog, menu, tooltip) may cast a shadow.

rules.name: The Scrim Rule
rules.body: A dialog dims everything behind it with the scrim colour; the base takes no input and a click on the scrim closes the dialog.

dos: **Do** express stage only with the flower colour from the six stage tokens (`stage-new` outline, `stage-planning`, `stage-pickable`, `stage-running`, `stage-closed`, `stage-rejected`).
**Do** use `primary` for exactly the main action of a view and `ink` for green text, links and the focus ring.
**Do** keep every neutral mint-tinted: chrome `#edf5ee` / `#0c110e`, lines `#d9e5db` / `#2a3a30`, text `#142019` / `#e4eee6`.
**Do** read colours from the active theme's tokens through the style functions in `theme.rs`; add a new colour as a token pair (Daylight and Night) first.
**Do** keep controls at 32px height and rows at 8px radius, 6px 8px padding, 2px apart.
**Do** put a tooltip on every icon-only button and name the shortcut where one exists (`Settings  (Ctrl+,)`, `Close  (Esc)`).
**Do** keep dialogs modal with the scrim, max 560px wide, footer pinned with Cancel then the primary action.
**Do** write weight, not size, to emphasise: 400 / 500 / 600 / 700 in 12 / 14 / 20.
donts: **Don't** recolour rows, tint backgrounds or add side stripes to show status; the flower is the status.
**Don't** introduce a Kanban board, a wide multi-pane layout or any pane beside the list; new surfaces are dialogs.
**Don't** use ICQ Green for decoration, or Running Green for a button.
**Don't** add shadows to anything that does not float; no gradients, blur or glass.
**Don't** add animation or transitions; the product is motionless by design.
**Don't** use pure grey, pure black or a cool grey; Night ground is green-black `#121915`, not `#000000`.
**Don't** use a second typeface, tracking, or sizes beyond 12 / 14 / 20 (plus plan headings 15 / 17).
**Don't** rely on colour alone: a stage needs the flower form (outline for New) and a label; a person needs a named tag.
**Don't** assume buttons are keyboard focusable in iced 0.14; every action reachable only by button needs a shortcut or an obvious pointer path.
